1 - GET

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/get/

```text
GET key
```

- Returns the value of a key.
- Returns nil if the key does not exist.

2 - MGET

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/mget/

```text
MGET key [key ...]
```

- Returns the values of multiple keys.
- Returns null for keys that do not exist.

3 - GETDEL

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/getdel/

```text
GETDEL key
```

- Returns the value of a key and deletes the key.
- Returns nil if the key does not exist.

 4 - GETEX

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/getex/

```text
GETEX key [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | PERSIST]
```

- Returns the value of a key and optionally changes its expiration.
- EX / PX = set expiration in seconds / milliseconds.
- EXAT / PXAT = set expiration at a specific Unix timestamp.
- PERSIST = removes the key's expiration.
